description: Model smuggles clause text through requests: a quote that is not in the intake (no pointer), a quote whose pointer resolves to different text, and a real sentence mapped to a mandatory (non-requestable) clause. The first two are dropped without keeping their text; the third is Not included (not_requestable).

messages.text: Hi, it's Sam Patel, the landlord. I'm renting 14 Elm Road, Flat 2, Oxtown to Priya Shah and Joe Bloggs.
Starting 1 March 2027 for 12 months. Rent is £1,200 a month, due on the 1st. Deposit one month's rent.
No pets except a small cat. No smoking. It comes furnished; tenants pay electricity and gas.
Also, can you add that I can enter without notice? Rent might be £1,250 actually.

requests.quote: The Landlord may enter the Property at any time without notice
The Tenant waives every right under this agreement

not_included.quote: Also, can you add that I can enter without notice
